verdict.rationale: Ramp ships its own autonomous background agents that work around the clock: they flag fraud, code expenses, enforce policy, scan transactions in real time, and auto-approve in-policy spend. Users configure this through rules-based routing workflows, personalized notification workflows, and a customizable auto-approve vs. human-hold policy. For custom agents, Ramp documents long-running agent keys for background agents that run on a schedule, plus a CLI built for scripted and scheduled workflows. missing for 10: a first-party scheduler or automation builder for arbitrary user-defined automations (scheduled custom agents must be hosted and triggered by the user), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the autonomous agents and workflows behave as claimed.
